description: This file defines the EnforcerRetriever class which provides methods to retrieve enforcer instances based on entity or enforcer keys, utilizing caches for efficient lookup within a security enforcement component.

classes.name: EnforcerRetriever
classes.description: A final class responsible for retrieving enforcers via caches, supporting lookup by entity key and enforcer key, with cache management and logging.

methods.name: EnforcerRetriever
methods.description: Constructor initializing caches for entity IDs and enforcers with dependency injection support for resource-specific enforcer caches.

methods.name: retrieve
methods.description: Retrieves cached enforcer data based on an entity key and processes the result via a handler callback, managing cache misses and logging.

methods.name: retrieveByEnforcerKey
methods.description: Retrieves the enforcer directly via its key, handling cache misses and invoking the callback with the result.
